A joint initiative by Two organisations. One mission for Bengal's farmers.

The big idea

A league built around better farms, not a stadium.

Like a sporting league, KRL brings teams, a season and recognition. But here, every participant’s farm is the playing field. The one-year journey focuses on visible farm transformation supported by modern practice, management and market connections.

The newer conversation calls for agriculture's 'Kapil Dev moment': a cultural shift that makes farmers visible heroes. KRL proposes learning, competition and storytelling to help create that shift.

“We are searching for the ratnas, the jewels among our farmers.”

Mahacharya Sourabh J. Sarkar, interview summary

02 · How a farm is scored

10,000 points. Four tests.

Every farm is judged on the same four values. Income carries the most weight, but a farm cannot win on money alone.

30%20%10%40%
3,000 pts

Satya সত্য

Truth and technology

Clean, residue-free harvests and honest, open use of technology.

2,000 pts

Mangal মঙ্গল

Goodness and soil

Rich dark soil, plenty of earthworms and village workshops that keep going.

1,000 pts

Sundar সুন্দর

Beauty

A farm that looks cared for, like paths lined with flowers.

4,000 pts

Samriddhi সমৃদ্ধি

Prosperity and income

Value of the harvest, net profit per bigha and profit that keeps growing.

The innovation escalator

The harder the upgrade, the bigger the score multiplier.

  1. A0.80×

    Basic upgrades: pump timers, rainwater harvesting.

  2. B
  3. C0.90×

    Joined-up systems: soil-moisture sensors, biofloc fish, vermicompost.

  4. D
  5. E1.00×

    Advanced smart farming: solar pumps run from a phone, drone field mapping without spraying.

05 · How the league runs

One Bengali voice app. No proof, no points.

OmniDEL.AI runs the whole league in four steps, the same for every farm.

  1. 01

    Plan

    The farmer tells the Bengali voice AI what they plan to do.

  2. 02

    Prove

    Photos and data are saved with time and place stamps that cannot be changed.

  3. 03

    Check

    The AI compares the new photos with the farm's starting point.

  4. 04

    Score

    Approved results go onto a public scoreboard that nobody can edit.

The proposed timeline

Three Puja milestones. One Bengal model.

2026

Launch and prototype

The plan calls for a statewide KRL launch, and the unveiling of a model farm at Munsibheri, built from a former dumpyard in 60 days.

2027

Season one finale

The target is 4,500 active model farms across Bengal and a Durga Puja awards ceremony for the announced ₹3 crore season-one prize pool.

2028

Pratyabartan

The long-term vision is a Bengal model of nature-aligned farming, rural enterprise and a living link between the diaspora and ancestral villages.

Applicant pathway

Know your next move.

Applications are not open on this site yetThe official link and dates will appear here after organiser confirmation.
01

Bring the mindset, not a particular age

Age is no barrier: what counts is the drive to build a model farm. Apply as a squad that meets the four squad rules in KRL Vision. Formal eligibility will come with the official rulebook.

02

Document where your farm is today

Prepare the location, approximate area, present crops or activities, current challenges and the change you want to achieve over one year. Official document requirements have not yet been published.

03

Use only the verified registration link

Registration is expected through the official organiser channel. Do not send money, documents or personal data through an unverified form or social account.

04

Join a team and start logging

Each selected farm joins one of the 15 teams, gets its Acharya and starts recording progress on the OmniDEL.AI app. Final selection rules will come with the official rulebook.

Personal readiness check 0/4 ready

Complete the checklist to prepare for the official application.

Questions, answered

What you need to know now.

Practical answers for farmers and supporters while the official rulebook is prepared.

What is Krishi Ratna League?

KRL is a proposed year-long agricultural league in which each participant's farm becomes the playing field. Farmers improve their farms, contribute to zonal team performance and compete for recognition and announced prizes.

Who can apply? Is there an age limit?

There is no fixed age. MahacharyaJi defines youth by energy and commitment, so an applicant could be 50 or 80. Farms compete as squads of five or more. Residency, land and document rules still need the official rulebook.

Is a large farm required?

No minimum area is stated in the source interview. It explicitly describes starting with the land a participant already has, whether one, two or ten bighas. Official eligibility may still add conditions.

Can I sponsor someone now?

Not through this website yet. Wait for the organisers to publish a verified sponsorship process, financial terms and accountability mechanism. Do not transfer funds through an unverified request.

When will applications open?

No confirmed opening date, closing date or live registration URL appears in the supplied source material. This site will display them once formally confirmed.

Who organises KRL Bengal?

The initiative is presented as a joint effort of Karmyog for the 21st Century and Bharatiya Krishak Samaj. Final programme rules and official application links should come from verified organiser channels.
